task.name: Set_up_common_yurt
task.when: During Build after the common-yurt footprint is approved

step.action: Confirm the yurt manufacturer instructions, part count, anchor plan, AC plan, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
Mark the yurt footprint and entrance without blocking a service lane or emergency exit.
Install the ground covering shown in the plan.
Assemble the yurt shell in the manufacturer's sequence.
step.ifThen: IF wind prevents control of a wall or roof section, THEN secure the loose material and stop.

step.action: Install every listed anchor and strap.
Have the Power Lead install any approved air conditioner and cable route.
Have the Build Lead compare the completed yurt with the final-state photograph.

passWhen.criterion: The yurt matches the manufacturer instructions and final-state photograph.
Every required anchor and strap is installed.
The entrance, emergency exit, and cable routes are clear.
The Build Lead and Power Lead completed their inspections.
